name: singlet_harmonization_geo_metadata_extraction
title: Extract normalised sample metadata from GEO and SRA records
description: Extracts organism, tissue, disease, cell line, perturbation, platform, technology and cell-count fields for each sample from its GEO and SRA text, with a verbatim evidence span and an ontology ID where one exists. The default method metasra_style links values to a pinned ontology release; rules uses exact lookup only and is the heuristic baseline. Writes uns/geo_sample_metadata, uns/geo_extraction_evidence and uns/geo_extraction_provenance. Do not use it to assign cell types or to edit source records; it reads text already attached to the dataset.

dataset.description: Dataset handle holding uns/geo_records; a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle.

ontology_release.description: Pinned release identifier for each ontology used to resolve IDs. Required; there is no default.

method.description: metasra_style links values to ontology IDs with fuzzy lookup and path scoring; rules uses exact lookup only.

fields.description: Target fields to extract; the default is all eight.

series_inheritance.description: series_fallback fills sample gaps with series-level text, marked as series-inherited; sample_only uses sample-level text.

negation_handling.description: Detect control, negated and untreated phrases before assigning disease or perturbation values.

min_confidence.description: Values scoring below this become null. Proposed threshold, tuned on the development split only.

cell_count_policy.description: report_as_stated keeps counts as written; flag_unclear marks counts whose unit or stage is unclear.

metasra_style.description: Options for metasra_style; ignored by rules.

fuzzy_max_edit.description: Maximum edit distance for fuzzy lexicon lookup; 2 is the MetaSRA radius.

fuzzy_min_token_length.description: Tokens shorter than this are matched exactly, never fuzzily, which blocks links such as CD4 to CD8.

cell_line_implies_disease.description: Whether a cell line name may fill the disease field.

device.description: Execution device; auto resolves to cpu because this task has no CUDA path.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/geo_sample_metadata. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Counts for completed runs: n_samples, n_values_by_field, n_null_by_field, flagged, grounding_rate and method. Never raw text.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
